theorem scalarSitePushforward_additive
    {C D : Type (u + 1)} [Category.{u} C] [Category.{u} D]
    {JC : GrothendieckTopology C} {JD : GrothendieckTopology D}
    (F : C ⥤ D) [F.IsContinuous JC JD]
    {R : Sheaf JD RingCat.{u + 1}} {S : Sheaf JC RingCat.{u + 1}}
    (b : S ⟶ (F.sheafPushforwardContinuous RingCat.{u + 1} JC JD).obj R) :
    (SheafOfModules.pushforward.{u + 1} b).Additive

title: Continuous module direct image is additive
statement: Let C and D be sites, F : C → D a continuous functor, R a sheaf of rings on D, S a sheaf of rings on C, and b : S → F_*R. The induced continuous sheaf-of-modules pushforward from R-modules to S-modules is additive on morphisms.

source.place: Tags 03EK and 0D6E; already proved generic subargument of blueprint sk-thm-purity-transport Step 10, moved from the assigned module for compile performance.

proof.text: The pushforward of a morphism is the same sectionwise linear map at each pulled-back object. On each section its value on the sum of morphisms is therefore the sum of their values. Extensionality for module sheaves proves preservation of addition.

proof_origin: K3 proved the sectionwise formula as a private instance. K1 exposes the proved additivity statement and registers it only locally, so that the public resolution theorem has no private instance in its type.
